title: Countdown over clock time
description: Keeps the countdown as the big inked number and adds the scheduled clock time as a small muted line stacked directly beneath it, so riders who want either reading get it without extra scanning. Hours format (1 h 4 min) keeps working as the top line.

changes.intent: Introduce a two-line group so the countdown and the derived clock time can render together without competing for the same baseline.
changes.detail: Wrap the existing .arrival-row__eta (and its .arrival-row__eta-unit children, unchanged) plus a new .arrival-row__eta-scheduled span inside a new .arrival-row__eta-group container. .arrival-row__eta-scheduled shows the same detail-only `scheduledTime` field described in eta-clock-time.json (derived as now + etaMinutes, formatted HH:mm). Rows in 'ahora'/'SALIENDO' state render only their existing label, no stacked clock line.

changes.intent: Stack the countdown above the muted clock time, right-aligned to match the eta column's existing alignment.
Secondary line should read as supporting detail, not compete with the countdown.
